questions.questionText:
Directions : Read the following information carefully and answer the questions given beside. 
“action packed night concert” is coded as “jio nul meb fot”
 
“star night out media” is coded as “ops hfa meb gul”
 
“media action report drama” is coded as “nul vis hfa dum”
 
 
“star strike media concert” is coded as “hfa gul fot sam”
 
Find the code for the word “strike out”?
questions.questionHtml:
Directions : Read the following information carefully and answer the questions given beside.
 

“action packed night concert” is coded as “jio nul meb fot”

 

“star night out media” is coded as “ops hfa meb gul”

 

“media action report drama” is coded as “nul vis hfa dum”

 

 

“star strike media concert” is coded as “hfa gul fot sam”

 

Find the code for the word “strike out”?
questions.solutionText: Correct Option: B Strike out is coded as sam ops. Hence option B is correct. Common Explanation: “action packed night concert” is coded as “jio nul meb fot” --- (1) “star night out media” is coded as “ops hfa meb gul”-------------- (2) “media action report drama” is coded as “nul vis hfa dum”--------(3) “star strike media concert” is coded as “hfa gul fot sam”------------(4) From (1) and (2) we get: night – meb ----- (5) From (2) and (3), we get: media – hfa ------ (6) From (2), (4) and (6), we get: star – gul ---- (7) From (2), (5), (6) and (7), we get: out – ops ----- (8) From (1) and (3), we get: action – nul --- (9) From (1), (4), (5) and (9), we get: concert – fot ----- (10) From (1), (4), (5), (9) and (10), we get: packed – jio ------ (11) From (4), (6), (7) and (10), we get: strike – sam ---- (12) From (3), (6) and (9), we get: drama report – vis dum (not necessarily in same order) ----- (13)
questions.solutionHtml:
Correct Option: B

Strike out is coded as sam ops.

 

Hence option B is correct.

 

Common Explanation:

 

“action packed night concert” is coded as “jio nul meb fot” --- (1)

 

“star night out media” is coded as “ops hfa meb gul”-------------- (2)

 

“media action report drama” is coded as “nul vis hfa dum”--------(3)

 

“star strike media concert” is coded as “hfa gul fot sam”------------(4)

 

From (1) and (2) we get:

 

night – meb ----- (5)

 

From (2) and (3), we get:

 

media – hfa ------ (6)

 

From (2), (4) and (6), we get:

 

star – gul ---- (7)

 

From (2), (5), (6) and (7), we get:

 

out – ops ----- (8)

 

From (1) and (3), we get:

 

action – nul --- (9)

 

From (1), (4), (5) and (9), we get:

 

concert – fot ----- (10)

 

From (1), (4), (5), (9) and (10), we get:

 

packed – jio ------ (11)

 

From (4), (6), (7) and (10), we get:

 

strike – sam ---- (12)

 

From (3), (6) and (9), we get:

 

 

drama report – vis dum (not necessarily in same order) ----- (13)
